answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding each identity to collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated agents sign conflicting histories, the correlated penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than as k independent fines. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling entity, with asymmetric depreciation rapidly exhausting escrowed stake and making large swarms uneconomic, even when identities are named pearl, vine, or umber.
